integrity: Exact integer transfer identities, direct signed invariant-face enumeration and independent mod-two boundary ranks are reproducible with the embedded standard-library Python checker. External published lemmas are cited, not independently reproduced in full; bibliographic novelty remains provisional until external review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns rational homology representations of the even-width ladder dominance complex for even \(n\ge4\); not integral lattices, odd widths, torsion in quotients, or quotient homotopy types. Equivariant traces are proved by finite-state identities; the nonequivariant concentration and rank invoke the cited Thapper cylinder theorem and the Matsushita-Wakatsuki duality.
title: Klein-four homology characters of even ladder dominance complexes
